scope: Five material studies across four rooms, not replacements for the current Option 1 gallery or budget.

requests.title: Pearl onyx · primary bathroom
requests.summary: Warm ivory and taupe onyx-look porcelain on the tub focal wall and shower walls.
requests.judgment: Most expressive bath option; stone stays concentrated around the bathing areas.

params.prompt:
Precise architectural interior PHOTO EDIT for a material study. Reference image 1 is the CURRENT Mineral & Walnut design and exact camera to preserve. Reference image 2 is the ORIGINAL MODEL-HOME PHOTO: use it only to verify architecture, never copy its obsolete furniture, palette or camera. Keep every window, door, wall, ceiling, crown, room proportion and urban view exactly as image 1. Preserve the furniture, walnut wood, natural oak where present, ivory textiles, black details, plants and lighting fixtures of image 1. Do not redesign the room. Replace ONLY the surfaces explicitly listed below. Physically credible porcelain tile/panel cladding with planned fine color-matched grout joints, coherent veining, believable thickness and neatly finished edges. Soft natural daylight with neutral white balance: warm ivory and walnut without pink/orange cast. Photoreal 4K architectural photograph, same 3:2 framing. No people, labels, watermarks, social-media UI, new arches, windows, ceiling trays, brass/chrome furniture, blue or yellow accents. This is the original warm Mineral & Walnut scheme, not Cocoa & Chrome.

MATERIAL STUDY A: Replace the far wall behind the tub, from floor to ceiling, and the visible shower wall surfaces at left with warm pearl/ivory ONYX-LOOK porcelain. Gentle translucent-looking cloudy mineral layers in cream, pale mushroom and restrained taupe; not actual translucent or backlit stone, no ice-blue grey or orange honey. Use large rectangular panels with subtle realistic joints, vein movement quiet enough behind the EXISTING single black-framed artwork. Keep that artwork, tub, faucet, flat ceiling, shower enclosure, frosted exterior shower window, dry right-hand window with roller, walnut double vanity, black sconces/mirrors, pale low-pattern porcelain FLOOR and small bath mat exactly. Keep the vanity-side dry wall in existing warm mineral finish. Third reference image is material-mood inspiration ONLY: borrow cloudy stone depth and large tile scale, never its room, window, tub or chandelier.

qa.note: Tub, shower, two windows, vanity, artwork and camera retained. Cloudy warm onyx is concentrated on the bathing walls; floor stays quiet. Daylight exposure and sconce brightness vary slightly from baseline.

requests.title: Soft limestone · primary bathroom
requests.summary: Cream limestone-look porcelain wrapping the bathroom walls.
requests.judgment: Quieter spa alternative to A; compare the same camera and furnishings.

requests.title: Warm marble · kitchen
requests.summary: Ivory marble-look porcelain backsplash with a restrained coordinated island surface.
requests.judgment: An architectural upgrade concentrated on the working surfaces.

requests.title: Quiet travertine · great room
requests.summary: Travertine-look porcelain restricted to the existing fireplace/TV projection.
requests.judgment: Adds mineral depth without turning the whole room into a stone interior.

requests.title: Pale limestone · shared bathroom

requests.judgment: A restrained everyday-bath treatment with the walnut remaining prominent.
